description: Canonical |tr_M(β_canonical(Z, N))| via Rust+Python: the Rust binary `hecke-canonical-chi` computes per-partition χ^λ(β) at H_n via direct f64 Hoefsmit (with averaged-crossing expansion), and this script combines with y_λ(q_0) from wedderburn_jones_markov to yield |tr_M| = (1/2^k) · |Σ_λ y_λ · χ^λ_unnormalised|. Replaces the broken tensor-product `rho_k_full_via_wenzl_lr.py`.
